id, tenant_id AS tenantId, report_id AS reportId, customer_id AS customerId, owner_staff_id AS ownerStaffId, team_id AS teamId, report_year AS reportYear, session_key AS sessionKey, first_open_at AS firstOpenAt, last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, visible_duration_ms AS visibleDurationMs, max_scene_reached AS maxSceneReached, viewed_scene_count AS viewedSceneCount, viewed_scenes_json AS viewedScenesJson, scene_durations_json AS sceneDurationsJson, ignited_lamp AS ignitedLamp, opened_order_count AS openedOrderCount, toggled_privacy AS toggledPrivacy, generated_poster AS generatedPoster, clicked_book_butler AS clickedBookButler, booking_task_id AS bookingTaskId, client_device AS clientDevice, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_annual_report ( tenant_id, customer_id, owner_staff_id, team_id, created_by, report_year, share_key, tone_code, tone_reason, display_name_snapshot, tier_label_snapshot, butler_name_snapshot, order_count, net_spend_fen, redeem_count, remaining_entitlement_count, snapshot_json, status ) VALUES ( #{e.tenantId}, #{e.customerId}, #{e.ownerStaffId}, #{e.teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{e.createdBy}, #{e.reportYear}, #{e.shareKey}, #{e.toneCode}, #{e.toneReason}, #{e.displayNameSnapshot}, #{e.tierLabelSnapshot}, #{e.butlerNameSnapshot}, #{e.orderCount}, #{e.netSpendFen}, #{e.redeemCount}, #{e.remainingEntitlementCount}, #{e.snapshotJson}, #{e.status} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_annual_report WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_annual_report SET status = 'DISABLED', disable_reason = #{reason}, disabled_by = #{disabledBy}, disabled_at = #{disabledAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE crm_annual_report SET status = 'DISABLED', disable_reason = #{reason}, disabled_by = #{disabledBy}, disabled_at = #{disabledAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND report_year = #{reportYear} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalReports, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeReports, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.visit_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openedReports, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedReports, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(v.visit_count, 0)), 0) AS totalSessions, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(v.total_visible_duration_ms, 0)), 0) AS totalVisibleDurationMs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.generated_poster, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS posterReports, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.clicked_book_butler, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bookingIntentReports, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene1, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene3, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene4, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene5, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.max_scene_reached, 0) >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachedScene6 FROM crm_annual_report r JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT report_id, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, COALESCE(SUM(visible_duration_ms), 0) AS total_visible_duration_ms, COALESCE(MAX(max_scene_reached), 0) AS max_scene_reached, MAX(generated_poster) AS generated_poster, MAX(clicked_book_butler) AS clicked_book_butler FROM crm_annual_report_visit_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY report_id ) v ON v.report_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.report_year = #{reportYear}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_annual_report_visit_session ( tenant_id, report_id, customer_id, owner_staff_id, team_id, report_year, session_key, first_open_at, last_active_at, visible_duration_ms, max_scene_reached, viewed_scene_count, viewed_scenes_json, scene_durations_json, ignited_lamp, opened_order_count, toggled_privacy, generated_poster, clicked_book_butler, booking_task_id, client_device ) VALUES ( #{e.tenantId}, #{e.reportId}, #{e.customerId}, #{e.ownerStaffId}, #{e.teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{e.reportYear}, #{e.sessionKey}, #{e.firstOpenAt}, #{e.lastActiveAt}, #{e.visibleDurationMs}, #{e.maxSceneReached}, #{e.viewedSceneCount}, #{e.viewedScenesJson}, #{e.sceneDurationsJson}, #{e.ignitedLamp}, #{e.openedOrderCount}, #{e.toggledPrivacy}, #{e.generatedPoster}, #{e.clickedBookButler}, #{e.bookingTaskId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{e.clientDevice} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_annual_report_visit_session SET last_active_at = #{e.lastActiveAt}, visible_duration_ms = #{e.visibleDurationMs}, max_scene_reached = #{e.maxSceneReached}, viewed_scene_count = #{e.viewedSceneCount}, viewed_scenes_json = #{e.viewedScenesJson}, scene_durations_json = #{e.sceneDurationsJson}, ignited_lamp = #{e.ignitedLamp}, opened_order_count = #{e.openedOrderCount}, toggled_privacy = #{e.toggledPrivacy}, generated_poster = #{e.generatedPoster}, clicked_book_butler = #{e.clickedBookButler}, booking_task_id = #{e.bookingTaskId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, client_device = #{e.clientDevice}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{e.tenantId} AND id = #{e.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, external_order_no AS externalOrderNo, source_system AS sourceSystem, order_type_code AS orderTypeCode, status AS status, paid_fen AS paidFen, refunded_fen AS refundedFen, ordered_at AS orderedAt, paid_at AS paidAt FROM crm_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELED') AND paid_fen > 0 AND COALESCE(paid_at, ordered_at, created_at) >= #{startInclusive} AND COALESCE(paid_at, ordered_at, created_at) < #{endExclusive} ORDER BY COALESCE(paid_at, ordered_at, created_at) ASC, id ASC

SELECT e.id AS entitlementId, oi.order_id AS orderId, e.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.category_code AS categoryCode, e.granted_count AS grantedCount, e.available_count AS availableCount, e.valid_to AS validTo, e.status AS status FROM crm_entitlement e JOIN crm_order_item oi ON oi.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND oi.id = e.order_item_id JOIN crm_project p ON p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND p.id = e.project_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.customer_id = #{customerId} AND e.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND e.available_count > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(e.valid_to, DATE('2099-12-31')) ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT r.id AS redemptionId, r.institution_id AS institutionId, COALESCE(NULLIF(inst.short_name, ''), inst.full_name, '合作臻选机构') AS institutionName, r.service_at AS serviceAt, rl.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.category_code AS categoryCode, rl.count AS count FROM crm_redemption r JOIN crm_redemption_line rl ON rl.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rl.redemption_id = r.id JOIN crm_project p ON p.tenant_id = rl.tenant_id AND p.id = rl.project_id LEFT JOIN crm_institution inst ON inst.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND inst.id = r.institution_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.customer_id = #{customerId} AND r.status = 'POSTED' AND r.service_at >= #{startInclusive} AND r.service_at < #{endExclusive} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_redemption_reversal rev WHERE rev.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rev.redemption_id = r.id AND rev.status = 'APPROVED' ) ORDER BY r.service_at ASC, r.id ASC
